verdict.rationale: Publishing delegated-access rules (third-party authorization forms, roles, and which signatures stay personal) is a fair question for a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no such documentation. The probes only show that the root serves a script-only application shell (12 characters of text) and that the long-published entry path returns 404. Neither says anything about third-party authorization.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
